title: Urgent action needed to safeguard the effectiveness of antibiotics
summary: With mounting evidence that antibiotic-resistant bacteria are continuing to spread and treatment options are becoming increasingly limited, urgent action is needed to safeguard the effectiveness of antibiotics, ECDC said on the occasion of European Antibiotic Awareness Day.
